games.name: Starjaunt
games.summary: You start with a shuttle.Not a warship. Not a legend. A shuttle, a modest hold, and enough fuel to reach somewhere that isn't here.What happens after that is genuinely up to you. Starjaunt is an open galaxy of forty-four star systems, nine factions with their own grudges and their own ships, and a war that keeps moving whether or not you're involved in it. You can spend the whole game hauling grain and never fire a shot. You can spend it taking systems by force. Most people do something in between and find out what that makes them.[hr][/hr]Pick a life, or don'tMerchant. Buy low, sell high, watch prices move as the war strangles supply lines. Trade up from a shuttle to a freighter to a hold that pays for itself.Miner. Work the asteroid belts, sell ore to refineries, stay out of everyone's politics.Bounty hunter. Hunt people who don't want to be found, across a six-part arc that gets more complicated the closer you get.Spy. Thirteen missions of intelligence work — planted evidence, two-stage extractions, freighter interdictions, and bribes that show up in your ledger as negative pay. Nobody stays clean.Combat pilot. Fly for a flag. Take contracts, take systems, take losses.Fleet commander. You don't need a carrier to stop flying alone. Make friends who fly your wing for nothing, hire guns at the bar who fly it for a fee, or earn enough trust from a faction's command that they stop handing you contracts and start handing you berths.Nine factions, and none of them are simply rightThe Federation — order and duty, expressed as slow ships with too much armor and a tariff schedule for everything.The Rebel Alliance — speed as armor, freedom as a grievance, captured tech held together with conviction.The Free Frontier — farmers, ice-miners and free-port harbormasters who want to be left alone and are squeezed by everyone. They fight defensively and they remember who helped.The Helios Combine — a megacorp that owns the mines, the patents and the foundries, sells arms to both sides, and does not want the war to end. Drone swarms, because people are expensive.The Artifact Order — monastic zealots who hold the Precursor ruins sacred and will ram your hull to prove it.The Federation Bastion — the hardliner splinter that thinks the Federation went soft. Siege doctrine, scorched earth, no negotiated peace, ever.Pirates, the Merchant Guild, and the Independent worlds that keep their heads down while everyone else fights.Each faction's mission arc unlocks its own hulls, one ship at a time, behind its own missions — fifty-four ships and forty-three weapon and outfit systems across the roster. Fly Federation long enough and you'll be trusted with a carrier. Fly for the Order and you'll be trusted with something stranger.The war moves without youSystems aren't decorations with a flag painted on. Control is a live number, and player missions push it. Take enough of a frontier system for the Rebels and it turns green on the star map — and then the markets restock from Rebel suppliers, Rebel patrols replace Federation ones, prices shift, standings follow, and the contracts on offer change with them. Contested systems spawn both sides at once and let them fight it out in front of you.Nothing about that is scripted. It falls out of one number per system, and it means the galaxy you're flying through in hour forty is not the one you started in.Nobody out here flies on railsThe pilots you fight weren't handed a patrol route and a state machine. They were trained — a neural network taught to fly by reinforcement learning, in simulation systems built for the purpose, until pirates learned to hunt traders and patrols learned to protect them.What comes out the other side is pilots with personalities. Some are reckless and some won't commit. Some break off a fight they're losing and some absolutely will not. They misjudge, they overextend, and now and then they do something you wouldn't have thought of. You end up reading them the way you'd read a person, because in the only sense that matters at knife-fight range, that's what the training produced.Land, and step outDocking isn't a menu. Set down and you walk the world on foot — desert outposts under prefab domes, forested colonies with lakes and lumber, company towns, garrisons, free ports. Find the fuel depot. Argue with the mechanic. Sell your haul at the warehouse and learn at the bar what's worth carrying next.You don't have to fly aloneThere are three ways to stop, and they cost you different things.Make friends. Twelve companions can be earned across the storylines — a cashiered Federation ace who flies angry, a homesteader who doesn't forget a kindness, a smuggler paying off a debt in escort hours. They fly their own ships, talk to you in combat, walk beside you when you land, and each has their own mission arc.Hire guns. Every bar has a wingman desk. Pay the fee and a veteran, a rookie or a mercenary flies your wing until they die or you let them go. When a hire dies you're out the money. When a friend dies you're out a friend — and there's a ledger for the ones who don't come back.Earn a fleet. Fly long enough for a faction and its command stops offering you contracts and starts offering you berths. Federation carrier certification, signed off by an officer who's watched you work. A converted capital hull the Alliance names you the first captain of. A deck on a Free Fleet carrier, handed over by a pirate king who decides you've earned it. Nobody sells you a fleet. You're given one, by people who had to be convinced.And past the last charted jumpSomething built the ruins at Tau Ceti and seeded the exotic matter at the fringe. It is gone, but not entirely.Out beyond Sanctum, through a jump that isn't stable, the Rift holds something dormant that answers when the relics are disturbed. It doesn't trade. It doesn't bargain. It doesn't hate you. It responds — and when it starts responding, the Federation's quarrel with the Rebels stops looking like the important story.How that ends is the one choice the game really asks you for. Seal it. Wake it. Or take it apart and use it.[hr][/hr]At a glance44 star systems across seven distinct regions — core worlds, contested borderlands, frontier reaches, company space, fortress systems, a monastic road, and a deep nobody comes back from134 missions, including six full faction campaigns that converge on the same battles from opposite sides54 ships and 43 weapons and outfits, most gated behind the factions that build themA live faction war that redraws the map, the markets and the trafficEnemy and civilian pilots flown by a reinforcement-learning policy rather than a scriptOn-foot exploration of every world you land on — deserts, ice fields, gardens, company towns, free ports12 companions to earn, mercenaries to hire, and fleets handed to you by factions that learned to trust you — companions who die stay deadThree endingsWindows, macOS and LinuxKeyboard only at launch.

Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around the world of Bluey and snap photos of the games they play and wildlife they discover. Each snapshot is saved to Bluey's scrapbook, where players can keep their favorite moments.

Share the adventure side-by-side! A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. You can even play with toys together along the way!

games.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

games.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages Demo
Creepy Tale: Snow Child
games.summary:
Step into the twisted, magical universe of Creepy Tale - a world packed with eerie secrets, original brainteasers, and minigames that'll test your wits, agility, and stealth. To survive, you'll need to leap over deadly traps, dodge sinister foes, and crack puzzles like they're no big deal.

Meet the mysterious - and downright dangerous - inhabitants of the otherworldly realm in this thrilling adventure where questing collides with action, and a gripping story ensures boredom stays far, far away.

games.name: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
games.summary: SHAKE a million!This is a homage to the famous App TAMAGO.But now it's time to shake. This brings the worldwide loved TAMAGO experience to an new level. Shake your million!Features:- 12 different eggs- 12 different sounds- a lot of shake funDISCLAIMER: Playing TAMAGO SHAKE too much can cause pain. You will use this app on your own responsibility.

games.name: Croc's World 5
games.summary:
Croc is back for his fifth adventure! 60 hand-crafted levels across 4 islands, packed with new enemies, huge boss fights and two brand new mechanics.

Millions have played the previous games in the "Croc's World" series – now it's time for "Croc's World 5"!

Run, jump and swim your way through swamps, ancient Greece, Egypt and the world of the Maya. Whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move, so you have to time your jumps carefully – and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling.

Features:
– 60 varied levels across 4 islands
– NEW: Gravity zones – walk on the ceiling in certain sections
– NEW: Constantly moving sections of the level – time your jumps
– Vastly improved graphics
– 4 different worlds: swamp, Greece, Egypt and Maya
– 4 wicked boss enemies
– Collect up to 3 stars in every level
– Retro mode with CRT screen effect for a true 80s feeling
– Lots of challenging enemies

games.name: Cubic Cosmos
games.summary: Cubic Cosmos is a thrilling fast-paced roguelike card game. You have been trapped in a deadly game. One wrong move could see you reduced to a plaything of the goddess. Can you free yourself from the endless cycle and escape your fate?

games.name: DESOLUS
games.summary:
Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.

An enigmatic cataclysm has fractured reality, opening portals which lead to other times. Explore the past and future versions of an expansive city.

Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes, traveling back and forth through time to make the city’s architecture whole again. Challenge your spatial thinking skills while navigating distorted realities as time becomes increasingly more unstable.

Partner with the city's mysterious guardian to prevent a cataclysm threatening to merge past and future. Unravel a haunting narrative to save the City of Desolus from complete annihilation.

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode.

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op.

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

games.name: Disney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. 

Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans.

games.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
Enshrouded
games.summary: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG for up to 16 players.

games.name: Freaky Trip: Puzzled
games.summary:
A cozy jigsaw puzzle game set in the world of Freaky Trip - piece together colorful, hand-drawn scenes starring Salcy and Cockapoo.

Salcy and Cockapoo are trading their chaotic rescue mission for a much calmer pastime. Grab a puzzle box, pick a themed pack, and start snapping pieces into place.

Choose from a growing lineup of themed puzzle packs - Pool, Fall, Winter, Camp, Garden, Space and more - each filled with hand-drawn scenes pulled straight from the Freaky Trip world, from building snowmen in the snow to floating around on pool rings under the palm trees. Pick your difficulty - Easy, Medium, or Hard - and enjoy the same oddball humor and cartoon charm fans know from the original game, now in a slower, cozier format. Completed puzzles are rated with stars, so you can track your progress pack by pack.

Features:
- Relaxing jigsaw puzzles starring Salcy and Cockapoo from the Freaky Trip universe
- Multiple themed puzzle packs (Pool, Fall, Winter, Camp, Garden, Space, and more)
- Three difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) for casual and dedicated puzzlers
- Star-rated completion tracking for every puzzle
- Charming, colorful art style true to the Freaky Trip world

games.name: French Fries Pusher Friends
games.summary:
Do you love French fries? Then this game is for you! A game where you push out fries with French fries to create a set of a burger, fries, and a drink. The goal is to fulfill as many orders as you can before you run out of HP. It's a challenge you wouldn't want to miss!

Enjoy both random and friend matching. You can experience a once in a lifetime meet in a random match, get excited with inside jokes in friend matching, and of course, it's also possible to play solo. Play as you prefer, and you can play with up to 4 people at the same time.

games.name: Ghost Dating: Hunt Spirits to Create Dark Anime Girls
games.summary:
They were terrifying once. Now they're irresistible. Hunt the spirits, unlock their dark side, and make one your girlfriend.

Something is haunting these streets, and it's not what you'd expect.

Graveyards, abandoned mansions, empty roads lit by something that shouldn't exist... and somewhere in the dark, they're waiting for you to find them.

Battle the spirits lurking in every shadow. Weaken them. Capture them. And watch as something dangerous and beautiful takes their place.

Every spirit you catch transforms into a dark anime girl with a personality pulled straight from the other side.

Build affinity, unlock dates, and discover what these girls are hiding beneath the darkness. The stronger the spirit, the more intense the girl waiting on the other side.


Features:

● HUNT & CAPTURE: Explore haunted locations and battle spirits in light combat encounters. Weaken them, catch them, add them to your collection.

● DARK TRANSFORMATION: Every captured spirit reveals a unique dark anime girl form, each with her own look, personality, and secrets.

games.name: GRID DEFENSE: GRID WAR - Full Access
Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary:
The mist of the Forest of Echoes now covers the land of Teradea, and outside of Bloomfield Village where you were raised, wild wolves appear at night. There are even rumors of a large guardian wolf that rules them all...but you and your best friend are about to change that!

Throwing caution to the wind, you’ll set out on a mission to tame those wolves and end up unlocking a journey far greater than you imagined. Help the Guardian Spirits to revive and revitalize Teradea! Visit the port village of Tidewind to uncover what’s causing the storms there. Trek to the mining village of Quarrytop to get to the bottom of the mystery of the earthquakes that are happening. Then, stay in the once-thriving town and cultural center of Maplehill to revive its fading light and community.

Between your travels, tend your farm, raise animals, harvest crops, and build a life for yourself. Guided by the Harvest Goddess and aided by the friends you’ll make in each of the villages, you’ll find new ways to grow, explore, and lend a hand wherever it’s needed. 

With the support of those you’ve helped - and those who stand beside you - you may discover a way to lift the veil from the Forest of Echoes and let Teradea flourish once more!

games.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Friendship Bundle Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary:
Making new friends is a big adventure. Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and restore an abandoned island to its former glory. Can you solve the mystery hidden within? With the new Friendship Bundle, enjoy the complete adventure with both DLC content packs, City Town and Wheatflour Wonderland. Packed with extra characters, quests, locations, and collectible fun, the bundle delivers over 60 hours of additional gameplay, giving you new areas to explore and dozens of new quests to complete.
With the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition enjoy enhanced features: 

    Embark on your cosy adventure to Friendship Island with higher framerates and smoother visuals 
    Celebrating, customising and crafting never looked so good! Enjoy enhanced resolution on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system 
    Playing with your friends is more fun with CameraPlay! 
    Prefer playing with a mouse? Joy-Con™ mouse support is here.

games.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction - Xenauri faction
House Flipper 2
games.summary:
It's time to dust off your hammer - House Flipper is back in a brand-new fashion! 

Buy and renovate run-down houses! Or maybe you want to build new ones? Now you can! 

Start as a rookie Flipper and make a fortune by helping out the community of the charming town of Pinnacove.

games.name: House Flipper 2 + Sakura DLC
games.summary:
Clean your worries away with this relaxing renovation simulator! Buy, fix, sell, and become a local legend. Or grab your power tools and build anything from scratch! With the online 2-4 players co-op mode, you can play both in sandbox and story mode together.

Spring has arrived, and the view is stunning! Now you can celebrate the sakura blossoms all year long with a whole range of beautiful, distinct items inspired by Japanese culture. From classic paper walls to Japandi furniture, from traditional painting and ceramics to smart bathrooms… 

This is your chance to have fun with new architectural styles or relax while designing a perfect zen garden!

games.name: Kyun-Cute Maid Puzzle! ~ Heart-Fluttering Maid Service Time ~
games.summary:
A breezy photo puzzle where you restore adorable maid snapshots and enjoy each completed scene!

Take a close look at the mixed-up slices, then rotate and line them up until the picture feels just right. The rules are simple, so even if you are new to puzzles, it is easy to jump in for a quick try.

How to play:
・Look closely at the maid photo
・Rotate each slice to the correct direction
・Line up every slice to complete the picture!

As you clear puzzles, you can enjoy a variety of sweet maid scenes, one photo at a time. It is great for a relaxed solo session or a quick little reset during a break.

Recommended for players who:
・Like cute maids
・Enjoy photo-based puzzles
・Want a simple, easy-to-play game
・Prefer relaxing solo play
・Want something light for spare moments

games.name: Melon Rally
games.summary:
Help Casey get his toys back by building crazy contraptions. Create Rube Goldberg-like machines with toys and everyday items to solve puzzles and playtime scenarios. See the solutions your friends came up with, and share your own instantly with Game Center.

The fun doesn't stop there! Create your own contraptions with the toys you get back, and challenge your friends through email to solve them. You can use slingshots, RC trucks, darts, ropes, magnets, balloons, trapdoors, punching gloves, and more. Let's see who can come up with the craziest inventions!

Highlights:
• Smooth, physics based gameplay.
• More than 30 different items to create contraptions.
• Over 70 levels.
• Level editor to make your own contraptions.
• Tight Game Center integration.

games.name: MeowMeow Balls
games.summary:
Punch Meow Balls and watch them roll! Bump, merge, and make them bigger!

A fun physics puzzle game where you roll cute Meow Balls!

●Punch the balls with a cat paw!
Use cat punches to send the balls flying, then merge matching balls to make them bigger.
The bigger the balls you make, the less space you have on the board. Keep playing without letting the balls fall!

●Meow Balls and cats!
The balls are cute, cat-shaped Meow Balls.
Collect Meow Balls and cats, then play with your favorites.
There's even a mode where cats jump in and cause some mischief!

●Go for high scores and best times!
Challenge yourself to get high scores and beat your best times.
Online Rankings let you compete with players from around the world.

games.name: MOBA Manager
games.summary: A deep MOBA esports management sim. You're the manager: scout talent, build the roster, manage finances and watch every match play out in real tower-by-tower detail. From local leagues to the World Championship, it's entirely your journey.

games.name: Play & Learn My First KANJI
games.summary:
Can you pick the right kanji? Make learning kanji fun! A great first step into kanji!

Ready to take your first steps into kanji? Pictures and familiar words make each question easy to approach.

Fill in the blank with the kanji that completes the word. This quiz is a fun way to get comfortable with kanji used in everyday language.

How to play:
• Look at the illustration and the word on screen
• Think about which kanji belongs in the blank
• Choose the correct answer from four kanji

There are no complicated controls—just choose an answer and move on to the next question. With 120 stages, you can learn a little at a time, review in short sessions, and enjoy steady progress.

Great for anyone who wants to:
• Get familiar with kanji for the first time
• Practice kanji and vocabulary through play
• Find an approachable quiz for young learners
• Think through questions together with family
• Enjoy a learning game in short bursts

Use the illustrations as clues and see which kanji fits. Take on all 120 stages and discover a variety of kanji and words!

games.name: Prison Run and Gun
games.summary:
Prison Run and Gun is a retro puzzle platformer with modern gameplay and mechanics.

The recent events in a state prison, involving Jake from Team HotGuns was a perfect moment for some prisoners to escape - you are one of them.

Use your skills and the guns to break through 30 sections standing between you and the freedom !

games.name: RATATAN
games.summary:
Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players.

An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee.

Defeat the enemies by riding the rhythm of Ratatan’s catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful, heartfelt adventure!

games.name: Robot City: Delivery
games.summary: Take control of the world's most popular delivery robot! Race through the neon city, collect packages, use boosts and hearts, avoid bombs and obstacles, and unlock new levels. Can you deliver all the packages and become the best courier?

games.name: Service Equals Survival
games.summary: Service Equals Survival is an incremental real-time strategy and tower defence game, where you are a commander tasked with eliminating as many bugs as possible. Featuring limb-damage on bugs, turrets, airstrikes, and barbed wire.

games.name: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs Demo
Solid Void - Halloween Nonograms
games.summary:
Light a candle, solve a nonogram, and watch the picture come alive. Fifteen haunted scenes are waiting to wake up.

It is Halloween night and you have the good chair. A candle burns on the desk, rain drums outside, and every so often lightning throws the whole room white. In front of you: a grid with numbers along its edges. Fill in the right squares and a shape shows through, like frost wiped off a picture. If you know these as picture cross or griddlers, you already know the dance.



Every grid you crack hands you a piece of a bigger picture. Set it on the paper, turn it until it fits, press it home. A gentle tutorial teaches the rules from nothing. No timers, no lives, nothing to lose but the evening, and your progress is saved wherever you stop, so play for five minutes or stay until the candle is out.

games.name: Super Arcade Soccer 2026
games.summary: Fast-paced, classic arcade football with a next-gen feel and pinpoint control. The 90s soccer feel you loved, rebuilt with modern physics and a fresh cartoon style. Just in time for the 2026 World Cup.

games.name: Tales of Eternia Remastered
games.platforms: PS5 · Xbox · Switch 2 · Switch · PC · PS4
games.summary:
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.

In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.

Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.

games.name: Tavern Talk: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Discover the cozy fantasy world of Tavern Talk Complete Edition, the first-ever physical Nintendo Switch release of the beloved visual novel adventure.

This Deluxe Edition includes the full base game along with both the Pirate Palooza and Tempest Tantrum DLC on cartridge, delivering the complete Wayfarer’s Inn experience in one definitive package.

games.name: The Mysterious Library
games.summary:
A visual novel containing over 50 short stories!

The Mysterious Library is a visual novel.
Read your way through a variety of books, including eerie tales, heartwarming stories, and strange yet humorous adventures.
You can change the background music, featuring pieces such as Nocturne, Gnossienne, and Gymnopedie.
Try to read every book and complete the entire collection.

games.name: The Nightmare Box Vol III
games.summary:
Following the collections of The Nightmare Box Vol. 1 and 2, released in 2025, The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 includes NO-SKIN, Menace from the Deep and Stasis. Digitally published by Feardemic, the titles in The Nightmare Box Vol. 3 will drag you into the depths of fear. 

Meridiem has been responsible for the design and manufacture of this game pack, which aside from the three titles includes a set of three tarot cards to add to the collection of cards from the previous volume.

games.name: The Screamer
games.summary:
A classic 1985 cyber-RPG! Known for a sleek world and a brutal system where character death erases save data, fans long for a re-release.

This title is a cyberpunk RPG originally released in 1985.

Upon release, it garnered attention for packaging designed to mimic a book. Despite being an RPG, its relentless system—where death results in permanent deletion of the save file—leaves lasting impression on players. However, crafted balance and decadent world-building continue to command a cult following.

Set in ruined post-World War III 199X, a colossal tower named "BIAS," built by Japan as a beacon, is now feared as the "Abode of the Devil." Requested by an acquaintance, the protagonist—a professional Hunter—steps inside this tower to investigate.

Will you be able to unravel the terrifying truth hidden deep within BIAS?

games.name: Three Nights: Moonfall - Blood Moon Edition
Tidy Up with Friends: At the Supermarket
Tormented Souls 2
games.summary:
After the events of Wildberger Hospital, Caroline yearns for a normal life with her younger sister, Anna. However, fate has other plans. As Anna falls victim to a mysterious affliction, coughing blood and experiencing blackened eyes and moments of unconsciousness, conventional remedies prove futile. In a desperate bid to save her sister, Caroline must turn to the supernatural.

Caroline Walker is back in the sequel to the award-winning classic survival horror. Stalk the halls of haunting monasteries and other nightmarish locations. Brace yourself to confront terrifying creatures armed only with makeshift weapons as you desperately try to rescue your cursed sister.

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! / Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
games.summary:
Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. 

Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. 

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles!

games.name: Train Sim World® 7: Freightliner BR Class 70 Add-On
Valkyrie Saga
games.summary:
Valkyrie Saga is an indie, retro platformer styled after PSX classics, giving you a chance to embark on an epic odyssey! 

Play as Roll the Valkyrie, a divine warrior tasked by the gods with one mission: Stopping a floating island from crashing into the earth. 

Ascend the ancient skyborne land, explore ancient ruins, unlock their secrets - and stop the cataclysm!

games.name: War Footing
games.summary: War Footing puts you in command of a nation's defenses. With limited time & resources, and tension rising, can you build the military needed to save your country's independence?

games.name: WhoIsHe
games.summary: A surreal point-and-click escape room mystery. Henry Grudge returns after seven years of being kidnapped, covered in blood and with no memories. Solve cryptic puzzles, search for hidden items, and uncover the dark truth. Who is he?

games.name: Wolfsschanze - Operation Gotterdammerung
games.summary: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

games.name: らくがきスマッシュ / Doodle Smash
A Game About Opening A Chest
A Game About Picking Fruits Demo
Bonds of Flame and Fate Demo
Cozy Cat Shop
games.summary:
※本作は日本語に対応しておりません。

街で一番居心地の良い「猫ショップ」を経営してみたいと思ったことはありませんか？

「Cozy Cat Shop（コージー・キャット・ショップ）」へようこそ！ここは、愛らしい猫たち、幸せなお客様、そして無限の可能性が出会う場所です。夢のお店を作り上げ、魅力あふれる様々な猫種と出会い、お客様が運命の猫と巡り合えるような、温かみのある空間を創り出しましょう。

最初は小さなお店からスタートし、賑やかな「猫の楽園」へと成長させていきましょう。スペースを広げ、インテリアを自分好みにカスタマイズし、ビジネスを拡大しながら、たくさんの愛らしい猫たちに囲まれる素敵な毎日を過ごしてください！

主な特徴：
- 多彩な猫種との出会い
- 居心地の良い猫ショップの経営・拡大
- お店のカスタマイズ
- ビジネスの成長

たくさんの愛らしい猫たちと出会いましょう！

games.name: Crab Evolution Roguelite
games.summary:
Can you build the perfect mutant and survive every dangerous stage?

Enter a dangerous pixel-art world where survival depends on how far you are willing to transform. Take control of a strange creature and fight through relentless waves of enemies in a fast-paced 2D roguelite where every run brings new dangers, new choices, and new opportunities to evolve.

Collect experience, discover powerful mutations, and reshape your creature with every decision you make. Combine passive effects, active abilities, and physical mutations to create unique builds that can completely change the way you fight and survive. Experiment with different combinations, adapt to unexpected challenges, and find the mutations that turn your creature into an unstoppable force.

Key Features:
• Powerful Mutations: Combine 60+ passive, 30+ active, and 30+ physical mutations to create unique builds.
• Transform Your Creature: Physical mutations change your character's appearance and shape the way you play.
• Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Fight through intense enemy waves in challenging 2D survival runs.
• 4 Unique Maps: Explore dangerous pixel-art environments filled with different enemies and challenging encounters.
• Every Run Is Different: Adapt to random mutation choices and experiment with new builds every run.

Fenestra: my focus, her future Demo
Fire and Water: Spirits of the Forest
Great Town Business: Life, Living & Luxuries Demo
I Was Summoned to Another World, but All I Do Is Organize a Run-Down Village
LEGO Harry Potter Collection

Learn japanese or die trying. •Learn 103 Kanjis from JLPT Noken 5 •Study all vocabulary related to kanjis from JLPT Noken 5 •All kanjis and vocabulary with audio files, in order to hear the correct pronunciation •Multilanguage available ( English, Spanish, Brazilian, Chinese, Korean, German, Japanese, French and Italian ) •Fude samurai has 6 world plenty of enemies to fight. •Game compatible with iPodTouch, iPhone and iPad

games.name: Moto X
games.summary:
Ready, set, go! Six riders compete only one will win!

Revive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994.

Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders.

Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage!

games.name: Penguin Colony Soundtrack and Director's Commentary
Resident Evil 2: Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
An unprecedented biological disaster that strikes Raccoon City drags rookie police officer Leon S. Kennedy and Claire Redfield, a college student who has come to town to visit her brother, into a tragedy unlike any they’ve ever faced. 

Amid this extreme situation where the living dead devour humans, will the two of them manage to survive?

An immersive gaming experience switched to over-the-shoulder perspective, the terror of zombies brought to life by the latest technology, and a story with even greater depth. Featuring a wealth of existing downloadable content, the game is reborn.

games.name: Resident Evil 3
games.summary:
Fight your way to freedom from the brink of despair. A series of strange disappearances have been occurring in the American Midwest within a place called Racoon City. A specialist squad of the police force known as S.T.A.R.S. has been investigating the case, and have determined that the pharmaceutical company Umbrella and their biological weapon, the T-Virus, are behind the incidents though they've lost several members in the process. Jill Valentine and the other surviving S.T.A.R.S. members try to make this truth known, but find that the police department itself is under Umbrella's sway and their reports are rejected out of hand.

However, soon reports of a grisly "cannibal virus" begin to surface, and vicious dogs begin roaming the streets. With the viral plague spreading through the town and to her very doorstep, Jill is determined to survive.
However, unbeknownst to Jill, an extremely powerful pursuer has already been dispatched to eliminate her.

games.name: Resident Evil 4: Gold Edition
games.summary: Resident Evil 4: Gold Edition

games.name: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer: Holiday Play Edition
games.summary:
Join in All the Reindeer Games - And Save Christmas!

Dash into the enchanting world of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer and embark on a quest to save Christmas in this magical adventure inspired by the animated classic! Journey through Rudolph’s winter wonderlands as you help Rudolph and his friends overcome challenges, enjoy joyful exploration, and experience cooperative gameplay in a festive adventure for the whole family.

The Holiday Play Edition includes the King Moonracer’s Kingdom of Misfits DLC Expansion:

Help King Moonracer find his toy soldiers who are scattered across the all-new King Moonracer’s Castle region. Venture through 6 secret doors, complete challenges, and search for 24 new bells. Featuring Sam the Snowman as a new playable character.

DLC Includes:

• All new region featuring six levels, a new storyline, and challenges.
• Added playable character: Sam the Snowman.
• New game mechanic "Sliding Ice" for exciting platforming challenges.

games.name: Swarm Me
games.summary: A minimalist horde survival arena where you’re hunted by an endless swarm of drones - kite the horde, bait them into deadly traps, upgrade your defenses, use special items and survive as long as you can. Every minute the swarm grows denser, faster, and deadlier.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. 

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

games.name: There is Cake in the Break Room
UNDERDEEP / アンダーディープ Demo
Winnie The Pooh Redux: Halloween Survivors Demo
Delivery Simulator
games.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

games.name: Rat Quest 2: The Quest For Moon Cheese Demo
Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle Demo

Carry Bros: Find It Together Demo
DuneCrawl
games.summary:
DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game where you and up to three friends explore the sandy seas atop a gigantic Crab Crawler.

Battle against the jar-headed Vassals, survive hordes of wild bugs, explore oasis islands and delve devious dungeons all to help your fellow Polloi pilgrims win their war against the Ceramicist’s invasion!

games.name: Father, Son and Holy Guns Demo
Frostpunk
games.summary: In a completely frozen world, people develop steam-powered technology to oppose the overwhelming cold. Society in its current form becomes ineffective and it has to change in order to survive.

games.name: Glooky: Cursors in the City Demo

SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit Demo

Classic Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Decades of classics and endless speed. Spin dash through iconic worlds, celebrate the legacy, and keep going in one epic collection of sonic adventures.

Sonic Mania
Experience classic 2D Sonic action with stunning retro inspired visuals, reimagined fan favorite zones, new bosses, and playable Sonic, tails and knuckles. Race, fly and smash your way through a nostalgic adventure with co op and competition modes.

Sonic Origins
Relive Sonic's most iconic adventures, including Sonic and the hedgehog, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Sonic 3 and Knuckles, and Sonic CD, fully remastered in high definition. Revisit the games that launched a legend and shaped generations of Sonic fans.

Sonic Superstars
Race through classic sonic platforming reimagined with vibrant 3D visuals, new chaos emerald powers, and an all new adventure. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles or Amy, team up with friends in 4 player co op, and take on Dr. Eggman and his allies across the Northstar Islands.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary:
I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

You are secret agent Alphonse Harding. Retired for six years, you've been asked to complete ‘one last job’, one too many times. Declining your latest mission sets in motion a furious guerilla war between you and the Covert Operations Initiative (COI) that litters the forest with bodies and bullet casings.

Break your opponents. Use their own equipment against them. Duck into your tunnel network before enemy forces zero in on your location. Repeat.

games.name: I Am Your Beast - Quitting Time DLC
Modern Sonic Collection
games.summary:
Three adventures and unlimited speed. Blast through alien amusement parks, rally a resistance, and explore uncharted frontiers in three epic Sonic adventures.

Sonic Forces
The evil Dr. Eggman has taken control of the world. Now you must defeat iconic old villains and fight a powerful new enemy to reclaim the world in this epic new adventure.

Sonic Colors Ultimate
Join Sonic on a high speed adventure to free the Wisps from Dr. Eggman's interstellar amusement park. Race through six vibrant worlds, harness powerful Wisp abilities, and overcome dangerous challenges.

Sonic Frontiers
In search of the missing chaos emeralds, Sonic becomes stranded on an ancient island teeming with unusual creatures. Battle hordes of powerful enemies as you explore a breathtaking world of action, adventure, and mystery.

games.name: Strange Tales of Holmes: The Sealed Cylinder
TWIN Hotel, Spa and More Demo
We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary:
You and your partner wake up inside mysterious pods. Strange machinery is buzzing around you, and the world beyond the glass is one you no longer recognize.

A calm, confident voice guides you through the unfamiliar facility, equipping you both with useful tools as you puzzle your way through a list of assignments together.

Left with many questions and few choices, you carry out the orders given to you.

Each assignment brings new asymmetrical puzzles that can only be solved through cooperation and trust. You will often find yourselves separated, relying solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. It’s up to you to describe what you see, share what you know, and piece together the truth as one.

With every puzzle you solve, you’ll come closer to understanding why you and your partner are here and what your role is in the facility. Only together you can decide what Tomorrow will hold.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow: Fan Edition
Hail to the Rainbow
games.summary:
The story of a lonely young man named Ignat, who survives in the dangerous and gloomy world of post-apocalyptic cyberpunk. The few survivors of the tragic military events had to adapt to the new conditions of existence. Ignat, who lost his parents, was able to build his life alone and learned a lot in this new reality.

However, the life of the protagonist, which has already become familiar in a few years, changes dramatically when an unexpected message arrives by e-mail.

"Hail to the Rainbow" is a first-person story-driven adventure game with horror and shooter elements. In the universe of the game, you will face the dangers of a new reality, immerse yourself in the secrets of the surrounding chaos, and also relive the memories and moral torment of the protagonist. 

Explore the environment, explore electronic records and solve technical puzzles, collect items and upgrade your inventory, this will come in handy on your journey.

games.name: Shoresy: Legends of the North
games.summary: Shoresy: Legends of the North brings the hit TV comedy series Shoresy (Hulu, Crave, Netflix, SBS) to life with a modern take on classic hockey video games. Enjoy fast-paced Sudbury Blueberry Bulldog hockey gameplay with hits, goals, fights, chirps and more.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

Developed by GPTRACK50, a new studio formed by veteran action game developers, Stupid Never Dies delivers a single-player 3D action RPG experience unlike anything you’ve played before.

games.name: Cotton Reboot!
games.summary:
Japan's favorite shooter mascot finally gets a worldwide release as a beautiful HD game with stunning graphics and remixed soundtracks. 

This is the original "Cute em' up", and will test your skills as well as tug on the heartstrings as Cotton and her friends are finally back in the ultimate celebration of one of Japan's most beloved gaming mascots. Choose between the HD Reboot mode or go legit with the X68000 original mode with pixel perfect graphics from the iconic Japanese home computer.

games.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
games.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

games.name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
games.summary:
Legends never die...

After more than 20 years, FATAL FURY / GAROU is coming back! Finally, the long awaited sequel has been green-lit.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Final Kick Football Legends
games.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

games.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
games.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

games.name: Moadra
games.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

games.name: My Friendly Neighborhood
games.summary:
Something is amiss with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show! For years, the colorful cast of The Friendly Neighborhood delighted audiences across the globe with their cooky capers and educational adventures. However, as time went on and interest waned, the production studio found themselves out of money and closed their doors for good.

Toy sales would dwindle, and birthday balloons and cakes would find new mascots. In time, the once household names would fade into increasingly niche fandoms. Until one night years later, the studio unexpectedly clicks back to life and starts broadcasting The Friendly Neighborhood. TV sets across the globe flicker for a moment before the familiar puppets return for a surprise encore!

Play as Gordon, a repairman sent to get to the bottom of this disturbing dilemma. Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

games.name: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
games.summary:
Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports!

Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls.

Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling—there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

Explore the island getaway using Joy-Con™ 2 mouse controls in Skateboarding, steer across the waves in Power Cruising, and tilt the controller to fly around freely in Prop Plane.

Create and customize your Sportsmate or Mii™ characters, and jump into the fun online* or offline** in Nintendo Switch™ Sports Resort!

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary:
Pre-order any digital edition and receive:

- Early access to the Open Beta*
- Hunter Killer Operator Skin** - Immediately unlock the Hunter Killer Operator Skin in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty®: Warzone™.

War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control.

Modern Warfare® 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.

- Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory.
- Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement.
- In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every extraction run into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.
